manifest_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: trousseau-hcvault
  namespace: kube-system
  labels:
    tier: control-plane
    app: trousseau-hcvault
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: trousseau-hcvault
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: trousseau-hcvault
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: trousseau-hcvault
        image: ghcr.io/ondat/trousseau:v1.1.0
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        env:
        - name: VAULT_NAMESPACE
          value: admin
        - name: VAULT_SKIP_VERIFY
          value: 'false'
        args:
        - -v=5
        - --config-file-path=/opt/vault-kms/config.yaml
        - --listen-addr=unix:///opt/vault-kms/vaultkms.socket
        - --zap-encoder=json
        - --v=3
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          runAsUser: 0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8787
          protocol: TCP
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8787
          failureThreshold: 3
          periodSeconds: 10
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 256Mi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: vault-kms
          mountPath: /opt/vault-kms
      volumes:
      - name: vault-kms
        hostPath:
          path: /opt/vault-kms
      affinity:
        nodeAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            nodeSelectorTerms:
            - matchExpressions:
              - key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane
                operator: Exists
violation_text: container "trousseau-hcvault" is not set to runAsNonRoot
